segments.an5.175:1.1: “Pañcahi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato upāsako upāsakacaṇḍālo ca hoti upāsakamalañca upāsakapatikuṭṭho ca [upāsakapatikiṭṭho ca (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)].
segments.an5.175:1.5: kotūhalamaṅgaliko hoti, maṅgalaṃ pacceti no kammaṃ;
segments.an5.175:1.8: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato upāsako upāsakacaṇḍālo ca hoti upāsakamalañca upāsakapatikuṭṭho ca.
segments.an5.175:2.1: “Pañcahi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato upāsako upāsakaratanañca hoti upāsakapadumañca upāsakapuṇḍarīkañca [upāsakapuṇḍarīko ca (pī. ka.)].
segments.an5.175:2.5: akotūhalamaṅgaliko hoti, kammaṃ pacceti no maṅgalaṃ;
segments.an5.175:2.8: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato upāsako upāsakaratanañca hoti upāsakapadumañca upāsakapuṇḍarīkañcā”ti.

lines: Kotūhalamaṅgalikoti “iminā idaṃ bhavissatī”ti evaṃ pavattattā kotūhalasaṅkhātena diṭṭhasutamutamaṅgalena samannāgato.
Maṅgalaṃ pacceti no kammanti maṅgalaṃ oloketi, kammaṃ na oloketi.
“Iminā diṭṭhādinā idaṃ nāma maṅgalaṃ bhavissatī”ti evaṃ bālajanaparikappitakotūhalasaṅkhātena diṭṭhasutamutamaṅgalena samannāgato kotūhalamaṅgaliko.
Ettha dakkhiṇapariyesanapubbakāre ekaṃ katvā pañca dhammā veditabbā.
